source.title: The global homeomorphism theorem for space quasiconformal mappings, its development and related open problems

trace.notes: Normalized one URL input as a zbMATH resolver source: https://zbmath.org/88782.

Direct zbMATH web fetch was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge/403. The zbMATH OAI-PMH endpoint resolved identifier oai:zbmath.org:88782 to document_id 88782, Zbl 0771.30017, DOI 10.1007/bfb0094243, author V. A. Zorich, and the title used in source metadata.

The DOI landing page at Springer confirmed the exact title and DOI but exposed only an abstract, references, and an access message for subscription content. The direct Springer PDF URL returned an HTML access page rather than a PDF. The Springer preview PDF was readable but contained only the first two pages of the chapter, not the open-problem regions.

Exact-work search attempts used the exact title plus PDF, the DOI plus PDF, and the book title with Zorich/open-problems terms. Candidate pages were rejected because they were metadata-only pages, retailer/library catalogue pages, a blocked ResearchGate full-text result returning error code 1020, or a non-source-authorized book-tracker listing. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.
